# clevercloud_elasticsearch_cluster (Resource)

Manage a dedicated Elasticsearch cluster on Clever Cloud.

The cluster is not exposed publicly: it is only reachable from applications
attached to its network group (`networkgroup_id`), at the host given by
`endpoint`.

Clusters have at least 3 nodes and cannot be updated in place: changing any
attribute recreates the cluster.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Elasticsearch cluster
- `plan` (String) Node plan defining CPU, memory and disk per node (e.g. M, L, XL)

### Optional

- `networkgroup_id` (String) Network group the cluster is reachable from. If not provided, the API creates a dedicated one
- `node_count` (Number) Number of nodes in the cluster (at least 3)
- `version` (Attributes) Elasticsearch version. Fields left unset will be chosen by the API (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--version))

### Read-Only

- `endpoint` (String) Host of the Elasticsearch cluster, only reachable from inside its network group (`networkgroup_id`)
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the Elasticsearch cluster
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for Elasticsearch authentication
- `username` (String) Username for Elasticsearch authentication

<a id="nestedatt--version"></a>
### Nested Schema for `version`

Optional:

- `major` (Number) Major version number
- `minor` (Number) Minor version number
- `patch` (Number) Patch version number
